parole.testo: From Old East Slavic субота (subota), from Byzantine Greek *σάμβατον (*sámbaton), from Ancient Greek σάββατα (sábbata), from Aramaic שַׁבְּתָא (šabbǝtā) or Hebrew שַׁבָּת (šabbāṯ). Cognates include Russian суббо́та (subbóta), Belarusian субо́та (subóta), Old Church Slavonic сѫбота (sǫbota), Bulgaria
